[IRET.13.2] **The op registry is `enum BuiltinFn`** (`proto/builtin_fn.proto`;
C mirror `runtime/src/libds/builtin_fn.h` as `enum ds_builtin_fn` / `DS_FN_*`),
reached through the native-rete `CallExpr.op`. Op values are
a **registry**: assigned once, never reused. A reserved
number has no handler and is never emitted; `proto/builtin_fn.proto` lists them, among them the
belief candset (`42,43`), the
byte/string conversions (`68,71-74`, [LSTR.4.6]) and the string distances
(`38,39`, [LEXP.5.6]). Representative op groups and
their handlers:

| Op group | Handlers (register site) |
|---|---|
| Actions `FN_EMIT` / `FN_LOG` / `FN_CALL` / `FN_PUBLISH` / `FN_CACHE_SET` / `FN_CACHE_GET` / `FN_CACHE_DELETE` / `FN_RATE_ALLOW` / `FN_RETRACT_CORR` / `FN_RETRACT_TOKEN_FACT` | `rete/adapters.c` (RT-safe) |
| Math / rounding `FN_ABS` / `FN_ROUND` / `FN_FLOOR` / `FN_FLOOR_TIME` / `FN_CEIL` / `FN_TRUNC` / `FN_SIGN` / `FN_SQRT` / `FN_POW` / `FN_MIN` / `FN_MAX` / `FN_DEGREES` / `FN_RADIANS`; bitwise `FN_BIT_*`; distances `FN_EUCLIDEAN_2D` … `FN_COSINE_3D`; `FN_REGEX_MATCH` / `FN_JSON_PATH` / `FN_JSON_HAS` / `FN_STR_LENGTH` / `FN_NOW` | `builtins.c` |
| Series reads `FN_SERIES_MEAN` … `FN_SERIES_ONSET_RATE`, `FN_SERIES_PERCENTILE` | `engine_rete_adapters.c` (op → agg-kind) |
| String/time/json adapters `FN_TO_STRING` / `FN_CALENDAR_TIME` / `FN_CALENDAR_DATE` / `FN_TIME_DATE` / `FN_UTC` / `FN_LOCAL` / `FN_MONOTONIC_NS` / `FN_JSON_BUILD` / `FN_JSON_VALUE` / `FN_GENSYM` | `rete/adapters.c` |
